The '''Zareca String''' was a vertical [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperjump]], accessible via the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]], which linked the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic disk]]. The route was charted during the [[Subterra Period]]. The term also referred to the line of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] suspended in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. These remote intermediate [[Star system/Legends|systems]] served mainly as supply depots and refueling stations. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] navigated the Zareca String during his quest to locate the lost planet of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].
